fight_technique_name: False Base Station Or Access Point
actions: Isolate the rogue cell via immediate RAN exclusion list update for IMSI/TAI (32) matching the NAS sequence.
Enable strict NAS message integrity checks for EPS sequence numbers, flagging values >20 as suspicious.
Deploy real-time NAS message rate limiting (10 messages/minute per UE) to detect spoofing bursts.
Enforce NAS message authentication codes (MAC) for all NAS messages, blocking unencrypted or mismatched MACs.
Update core network to reject NAS messages with nested_field1_show values >5, defaulting to 0.
Deploy NAS sequence number tracking per UE, alerting on unexpected jumps or resets.
Configure RAN to enforce NAS message size limits (≤256 bytes), dropping oversized packets.
Enable NAS message replay detection via sequence number history (last 100 messages per UE).
Trigger automated RAN cell blacklisting for gsm_a_common_elem_id=11, assuming spoofed authentication attempts.
Monitor NAS message patterns for anomalies in nested_field1_unmaskedvalue, flagging deviations from baseline.
